title: On $S$-prime and $S$-primary elements in multiplicative lattices
summary: In this paper, we study $S$-prime elements and $S$-primary elements within the framework of multiplicative lattices. Furthermore, we define and explore weakly $S$-prime elements and weakly $S$-primary elements, which generalize weakly prime elements and weakly primary elements in multiplicative lattices respectively. We show that the weakly $S$-prime ideals (weakly $S$-primary ideals) of a commutative ring $R$ with $1$ correspond precisely to the weakly $S_L$-prime elements (weakly $S$-primary elements) of the ideal lattice $Id(R)$ of $R$, where $S_L = \{(s) \mid s \in S\}$.
